_comment: Fixture Blueprint for the row-scoping tests. ONE source for both halves:
run-ownership-tests.sh renders src/lib/ownership-rules.ts from this doc with
the real projection, and ownership-scope.test.mts builds its tables and rows
from the same entities. A test that hand-wrote the manifest would pass while
Invoice is scoped to its owner, with admin exempt. Announcement carries an
attribution rule: postedByUserId is filled from the session but must never
narrow a read - the case a name-based heuristic would get wrong, and the one
the live ATS blueprint depends on. Ticket is drift: the rule names a column
the table does not carry, and the engine has to fail closed on it.

ownershipRules: Announcements are company-wide: every signed-in user reads every row. postedByUserId records who wrote one and is never an access filter.

ownershipRules.note: An invoice belongs to the user who raised it.
Drift fixture: names a column the projected table does not carry.
Filled from the session; must not narrow any read.
